_comment: GIST-960 (1M, 960d L2). High-dim SPANN: posting_vector_limit auto-derives to ~17 from `dim` to keep one posting close to the NVMe ~64 KB read sweet spot (vs SPTAG's 118 default, which would push every posting to ~720 KB at 960d). posting_page_limit/search_posting_page_limit set to 20 — above the 16-page physical floor (`ceil(17 * (960*4+4) / 4096)`) with headroom. head_ratio=0.30 (vs 0.25 for 96-128d) because in high dim head quality dominates recall. internal_result_num=128 / max_check=16384 widen search candidates. num_threads/io_threads=32 caps build wall-clock.
